newsitem.title: FRANCE: Total to gain Yemen Marib oilfield stake.
newsitem.headline: Total to gain Yemen Marib oilfield stake.

text.p: Total SA will gain a stake in Yemen's Marib oilfield from 2005 in a deal involving operators Hunt Oil and Exxon Corp, Total chairman Thierry Desmarest said on Wednesday.
Hunt, Exxon and Yukong recently joined the Yemen Liquified Natural Gas (LNG) company, a refining and marketing venture between Total, 70 percent, and the state-owned Yemen Gas Company.
Following the deal, Total will have 36 percent, Yemen Gas 26 percent, Hunt 15.1 percent, Exxon 14.5 percent and Yukong 8.4 percent stakes.
The Yemen LNG company will process gas which is a byproduct from the Marib oil field.
The present Marib licence expires in 2005. After that, the production licence will be owned by both Yemen Exploration and Production Company (YEPC) -- a Hunt/Exxon joint venture -- and Yemen LNG.
"The importance is that Total will be associated with both the downstream and the upstream side of the field," a company spokesman said.
